name: Vishnu Bajpai
subhead: Martech, RevOps and growth. Currently Martech Manager at a global fintech group.
intro: I work where CRM, marketing and technology meet. For 5+ years I've built lifecycle journeys on Braze, lead and pipeline operations on Salesforce, and the RevOps and martech plumbing that connects marketing, sales, product and data, contributing to ₹20Cr+ in revenue impact.
openTo: Open to Martech, RevOps and Growth leadership roles

uplift.title: What fixing the funnel was worth
uplift.note: Each stage indexed to 100 before the fix. Bars show the change after it; axis starts at 70 so the gain is visible.

warehouse data piped into Braze for multiple brands

impacts.p: Lapsed users bought back with paid ads
impacts.s: churned users across email, push, WhatsApp and in-app

CRM and lifecycle: Omnichannel: email, push, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app

statements.h: I build the systems that turn acquisition spend into retained revenue.
statements.s: Lifecycle CRM on Braze, pipeline operations on Salesforce, and the data that connects them.

statements.h: I get marketing, sales and product running on one go-to-market engine.
statements.s: Shared funnel definitions, clean hand-offs and one roadmap ranked by business impact.

statements.h: I find where revenue leaks between teams, tools and data, and close it.
statements.s: MQL to SQL up 20%, lead response time down 35%, effective CAC down 12%.

statements.h: I turn martech stacks into growth infrastructure, not tool sprawl.
statements.s: Roadmaps, integrations and platform migrations that ship on time, 95%+ of the time.

statements.h: I design customer journeys that earn the second purchase, not just the first.
statements.s: Onboarding, loyalty and win-back journeys that lifted repeat purchases 18% and LTV 12%.

statements.h: I connect customer data to every channel, so personalisation actually works.
statements.s: Warehouse-to-CRM pipelines and event design that improved segmentation accuracy 35%.
